data.name: Fantastic journey
data.detailed_description:
to be continued...

For your information, this app (Fantastic Journey) is the first developed by Nouveau Souffle. Several other journeys are in preparation and will be available this year. Purchase these first two dreamlike and fantastical journeys and enjoy their content to get an idea of ​​what's coming soon. Happy travels!


About the Game

Imagine yourself in a hot air balloon, soaring over the Arctic with its glacial landscapes, escaping to the North Pole with its aurora borealis, then finding yourself in a dreamlike world of suspended rocks, finally reaching the cosmos beyond the stars, all accompanied by enchanting music. You are a passenger on a hot air balloon that will guide you, with nothing to manipulate or do but discover amazing worlds.

No need joystic nor keyboard, juste launch the game and travel through this wonderful world.16 minutes of pure pleasure.
